properties.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 14 at 11:16AM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For eastern portions of the valleys, northeast to east winds
20 to 30 mph with gusts 45 to 55 mph expected, locally higher near
mountain foothills. For the western valleys, more localized wind
gusts 35 to 45 mph. Strongest and most widespread winds will be on
Friday.

* WHERE...San Diego County Valleys.

* WHEN...From 8 PM Thursday to 8 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds will blow down trees and power lines.
Widespread power outages are expected. Travel will be difficult for
high profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will become easterly on Saturday.
properties.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind.

NWSheadline: HIGH WIND WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 8 PM THURSDAY TO 8 PM PDT SATURDAY
